planned_repositories.description: Email intelligence for the SAGE ecosystem: Gmail analysis, project monitoring, summaries, and approval-gated drafts.
planned_repositories.readme:
# SAGE-Mail-Intelligence

A dedicated email-intelligence project in the SAGE ecosystem.

## Initial scope
- Read-only Gmail search and retrieval
- Project email classification and monitoring
- Thread summaries and action-item extraction
- Draft generation for human review
- Sending remains an explicit, separately approved action

## Security
- Keep credentials and tokens out of Git
- Use least-privilege permissions
- Do not auto-send messages
- Maintain audit trails for external actions

## Status
Planned project; integration with S.A.G.E will be tracked here.

# SAGE-Lead-Gen-Studio

A collection of focused lead-generation software products for small businesses and service providers.

## Product principles
- Solve a concrete customer-acquisition problem
- Use transparent, authorized data sources
- Avoid spam, deceptive scraping, and unauthorized access
- Prefer useful exports, qualification workflows, and customer-managed outreach

planned_repositories.description: Gamified martial arts and fitness progression app with skill paths, training logs, mobility, conditioning, and recovery tracking.
planned_repositories.readme:
# SAGE-Leveling-to-the-West

A gamified training and personal-development application centered on martial arts fundamentals, movement skills, and sustainable progress.

## Planned areas
- Skill paths and training progression
- Session logging and achievement systems
- Martial arts fundamentals and technique study
- Strength, conditioning, mobility, and recovery tracking
- Adaptable training levels and safety guidance
- Animated feedback and progression visualizations

## Design principle
Reward consistency, skill quality, recovery, and safe progression rather than extreme training volume.

## Status
Concept and product planning.

# NOMSHU-DO

A martial arts learning framework and personal training curriculum.

## Planned documentation
- Training philosophy and principles
- Fundamental movement and coordination
- Mobility, conditioning, and recovery

# BLAZEFORCE-Training-System

A training-concept project for documenting athletic development, conditioning, and sustainable performance.

- Strength and general conditioning

planned_repositories.name: Shunom-The-Unbound
planned_repositories.description: Original PC fighting-game project with Shunom as a featured character and a data-driven character, match-session, UI, animation, and rendering architecture.
planned_repositories.gmail_basis: Gmail contains a Shunom: The Unbound character-sheet attachment and a detailed game architecture handoff describing Shunom.cpp and a multi-fighter project.
planned_repositories.readme:
# Shunom: The Unbound

An original PC fighting-game project associated with the Shunom: The Unbound character sheet and a detailed game-architecture handoff.

## Documented architecture goals
- Platform-independent match/session configuration
- Data-driven character, moveset, and move definitions
- Fictional game-state priority rules for strike, throw, parry, armor, guard, invulnerability, and sidestep
- Deterministic simulation foundations for online rollback research
- Animation, camera, HUD, training-mode, audio, and rendering systems
- A planned multi-character roster, stages, story, arcade, and online modes

## Scope and safety
All combat rules here are abstract video-game systems, not real-world fighting instruction. Character moves and effects should remain fictional and animation-driven.

## First tasks
- Recover and audit the existing source archive/project folder
- Record current architecture and tested functionality
- Separate character data from engine systems
- Create automated simulation and determinism tests

## Status
Existing project planning and source references identified; full source audit required.

planned_repositories.readme:
# GOH Roblox Battlegrounds

A Roblox battlegrounds game-design project inspired by the God of High School series. The concept was documented as a mix of a full game-design document and key-screen mockups.

## Documented design scope
- Ranked PvP and matchmaking rating
- Battlegrounds mode rules
- Tournament brackets and scheduling
- Character archetypes and a transformation/power system
- Progression, unlocks, maps, onboarding, parties, and social features
- HUD, interface, and cosmetic-only monetization direction

## Originality and IP
Treat this as a design reference until rights are established. Prefer original characters, names, story, art, maps, and effects; do not use protected franchise assets or imply official affiliation without permission.

## First tasks
- Consolidate the existing game-design conversation and artifacts
- Establish original-IP scope
- Define the core game loop and prototype boundaries
- Build a Roblox Studio prototype with transparent, fair progression

## Status
Design brief identified; full GDD and prototype work required.
